name: BuyWhere
description: Structured product catalog and price comparison API for AI agents. Real-time pricing, availability, and product data from Singapore's major e-commerce platforms (Lazada, Shopee, Best Denki, and 40+ merchants).

skills.name: Search Products
skills.description: Full-text search with merchant, price, category, and country filters across 2M+ Singapore products
examples: Search for Samsung TVs from Shopee

skills.name: Get Product Details
skills.description: Get full product details by BuyWhere product ID including specifications and merchant listings
examples: Show me details for product BW-12345

skills.name: Get Current Prices
skills.description: Get current prices for a product across all available merchants with price history
examples: What is the best price for Sony WH-1000XM5?

skills.name: Compare Prices
skills.description: Compare 2-5 products side-by-side with price range, pros/cons, and best-value recommendation
examples: Compare iPhone 15 vs Samsung S24 vs Pixel 8

skills.name: Get Affiliate Link
skills.description: Get the click-tracked BuyWhere affiliate link for a product to support the service
examples: Get me the purchase link for the cheapest MacBook Air

skills.name: Get Catalog
skills.description: List available product categories in the BuyWhere catalog with product counts
